fields.subject: SequenceLengthening
fields.where: a retry backoff has a base interval and an attempt number
fields.trigger: retry-delay resolution selects a SequenceLengthening value
fields.response: map Linear to attempt × interval, HalfSquare to floor(attempt² / 2) × interval, Squaring to 2^(attempt − 1) × interval, and Lengthening (the default; its obsolete alias Fibonacci has the same value) or an unrecognized value to (attempt + attempt − 1) × interval — the odd-number progression 1, 3, 5, 7… × interval
fields.postcondition: the resulting duration is returned in milliseconds
